work.title: Main-guard reverts: classify the last-pusher approval-rule refusal, keep red-main visible every cycle, and surface the unconfigured revert approver before a red main

criteria.text: Readiness surfaces the fault before a red main: doctor and master status's setup attention report the revert approver as missing — naming GRAPHYARD_REVERT_APPROVER_APP_ID/_INSTALLATION_ID/_PRIVATE_KEY and the last-push-approval rule on main — whenever GitHub delivery with required checks is armed and the approver is unconfigured, and clear once it is configured.

With the revert approver configured, a guard revert of a merge that broke main is approved by the independent approver App at the verified head and merges under last-push protection; with it unconfigured, the refusal stays visible through AC-3 so the 2026-10-05 pattern (five silent abandonments, red main until an unrelated merge) cannot recur unnoticed.
